name: Project X - Hero Chronicles
source:
The fate of the world rests in her hands...

Shield Rising is a popular game among high schoolers. Recently published and in beta testing, players all across the globe compete. But one day, all the players are sucked into the game! Whoever beats the final boss gets out. If you die in the game, you die in real life. 

Who will betray you? Who will be your allies? Find out in Project X - Hero Chronicles.

[From [url=https://otakuchama.itch.io/project-x-hero-chronicles]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界的命运掌握在她的手中……

Shield Rising是一款深受高中生欢迎的游戏。最近发布并正在进行Beta测试，全球各地的玩家都在竞争。但有一天，所有的玩家都被卷入了游戏之中！谁打败了最终的boss就出去。如果你在游戏中死了，你在现实生活中也会死。

谁会背叛你？谁将成为你的盟友？在X计划 - 英​​雄编年史中找到答案。

[来自[url=https://otakuchama.itch.io/project-x-hero-chronicles]Itch.io[/url]]
